_doc: DEV-OWNED hardware slotmap (the artist file assets/palette.txt holds colors + ramp rows only). Ramp name -> hardware slot; tiles, art, UI and OBJ code consume fixed indices (see tools/palette_txt.py hard_consumers()). To move a ramp, change its number (never reorder blindly). Unmapped ramps must be listed under spares (never silently dropped, never auto-assigned into a live slot).

BASE._note: bow/gold shares slot 0 fight1; see UI_COLOR_GOLD in src/ui/ui.h.

OBJ._note: 0: bats/spiders/kobolds/hero OW; 1: fire/mimic OW; 2: dog OW; 3: slime OW; 5: boss OW + OAM bats; 6: OAM mimics. Slots 4/7 unmapped by design: battle-time scratch, programmed per battle entry (red pads at boot mark them scratch -- never art). Battle OAM values live in RAMPS/BATTLE, programmed per battle entry -- never static slots.

spares._doc: Deliberate spares: defined ramps with no hardware slot (board is full). The checker reports them as spare by design instead of failing on unmapped ramps. Promote to slots when a slot frees (e.g. spider flip frees BASE 2 for fight2).
